technique_name: Describe a process to deploy a web app using an Amazon EC2 instance.
description: The process for deploying a web app on an Amazon EC2 instance involves several steps. First, you will need to create an Amazon account and set up an EC2 instance. Once the instance is created you will need to configure the instance with the necessary software and settings to run your web application.
